name: Farnaz brain
rule: Shared knowledge. Do not rewrite apps/local_agent internals. ChatGPT may READ this file.
dsp_brain: Thall DSP chain: HP(Low Cut+TIGHT) -> Tight shelf -> Body peak -> Drive -> tanh waveshaper(MORPH) -> Bite -> Air -> Gate -> Delay/IR SPACE -> Mix/Trim. Filters before shaper. ADAA native only: y=(F(xn)-F(xn-1))/dx with relative eps, stable ln(cosh), denormal flush, MORPH=two ADAA blends. Cousin algebraic f=x/sqrt(1+x^2). Do not STFT-waveshape. SPACE is overlap-save / partitioned IR after gate. Mix energy in MIX_READY.md.

cards.tags: thall chain lowcut tight body drive shaper bite air gate space trim
cards.fact: Thall DSP order: Input -> Highpass (Low Cut + TIGHT) -> Highshelf Tight -> Peaking Body -> Drive gain -> tanh waveshaper (MORPH) -> Peaking Bite -> Air shelf -> Gate -> Dry/Delay/Reverb mix -> Engage bypass -> Stereo/Mono -> Master+Trim. Filters before the shaper; Bite after. Never put the shaper first or bass mud makes harmonics you cannot cut.

cards.tags: waveshape tanh morph gain harmonic even odd
cards.fact: Waveshaping is y=f(x) per sample. Symmetric f (odd) -> odd harmonics. Asymmetric f -> even harmonics (tube-like). Thall table: amount=1.4+GAIN^2*22; modern=tanh(x*amount); asym=tanh(x*1.2) on +, tanh(x*0.82) on -; MORPH crossfades them. Drive gain before the table is 0.72+GAIN^2*5.8.

Oversampling: upsample xL, run the nonlinearity, lowpass, downsample. Stops harmonics above Nyquist folding back as metallic alias. Thall WaveShaper uses 4x default, 2x, or OFF. Only the shaper is oversampled. Harder clip needs higher L. Live guitar prefers minimum-phase IIR; quality FIRs add latency.

cards.tags: adaa antiderivative antialiasing parker zavalishin tanh
cards.fact: ADAA (Parker/Zavalishin DAFx-16): y=(F(x[n])-F(x[n-1]))/(x[n]-x[n-1]) with F'=f. If |dx|<eps use f(x). First-order tanh uses F=ln(cosh). Cheaper cousin: f=x/sqrt(1+x^2), F=sqrt(1+x^2). ADAA kills in-band aliases; oversampling kills high folding. Best together (ADAA+2x). Adds 1 sample delay. Native VST can do this; the browser WaveShaper cannot - it only oversamples.

cards.tags: gate envelope hysteresis attack release worklet
cards.fact: Warlock gate is a sample-wise worklet: peak magnitude, exponential envelope (~1.5ms attack, 55-185ms release from GATE), threshold 0.00008+0.0085*GATE^2, hysteresis close at 0.58*threshold, gain smoothed with smoothstep g^2(3-2g). GATE~0 stays open. UI attack/hold/release labels are not the kernel yet.

After the gate: dry, delay (75ms+MORPH*280ms, wet up to 22% SPACE), and short convolver reverb (wet SPACE^1.4*0.34). MORPH both tints the shaper and stretches delay. LEVEL*TRIM(dB) on master. Bypass compensates loudness so Engage does not jump.

cards.tags: ui layout sound chat send touch farnaz
cards.fact: Lab layout: menus on top, tools left, program page left-wide, canvas center, inspect+Farnaz right. SOUND tab: RECORD/DEMO/MORPH readout are the primary cluster; DSP details below. Chat: SEND is the only loud action. System status is PROJECT line (e.g. MORPH . MOVE). Farnaz icon lives bottom-left; click opens CHAT.
SKU THALL - Warlock Thall, native VST3, in development. Flagship product of WARLOCK Plugins Factory. Owner Soheil.

cards.tags: desktop vision mouse keyboard workflow permission see apps click type launch
cards.fact: Farnaz Desktop Operator is default-deny. Caps: see, apps, click, type, launch, workflow. Grant with confirm=true. Loopback 127.0.0.1:8766 only. Does not touch apps/local_agent. Screenshot stays local. Type rejects secrets. Max 8 workflow steps.

cards.tags: adaa numerical stability ln cosh eps denormal morph
cards.fact: ADAA stability: eps = 1e-6*(1+|x|+|x1|); if |dx|<eps use 0.5*(f(x)+f(x1)). Stable F_tanh = |x|+log1p(exp(-2|x|))-ln(2). Asym tanh(a x) has F=ln_cosh(a x)/a with a clamped. MORPH blends two ADAA outputs, not two f then one F. Denormal x1->0. Non-finite -> 0 and reset. NUMERICAL_SAFETY is NOT_RUN until tests. Factory Test has no ADAA yet.

cards.tags: tanh algebraic atan cubic cousin waveshape eco
cards.fact: Clip families: tanh+ln_cosh = THALL default. Cousin x/sqrt(1+x^2), F=sqrt(1+x^2) = ECO. x/(1+|x|) utility not brand. atan darker/more CPU. cubic simple Factory not MORPH. Symmetric=odd, asymmetric scale=even. Switching family requires GAIN^2 recalibrate and golden approve. Do not silently replace tanh.

cards.tags: fft stft frequency domain iir fir latency
cards.fact: Time domain: tanh ADAA gate IIR filters. Frequency domain: partitioned IR and offline Audio Lab FFT. Never waveshape inside STFT. Oversampling is still time (upsample-ADAA-downsample). Live guitar: min-phase IIR. Linear-phase FIR/STFT must report latency. Analysis FFT is not the plugin run().

cards.tags: overlap-save ols convolution fft circular wrap
cards.fact: Overlap-save: FFT multiply is circular. IR length M, FFT N>=2M. Prefix previous M-1 samples, FFT, multiply H(f), IFFT, DISCARD first M-1 (wrap), keep next L. That is linear convolution. Hop L. Overlap-add keeps tails instead. WARLOCK SPACE uses overlap-save / uniform partition, not one huge FFT per host buffer.

cards.tags: ir convolution partitioned space license latency cab hall
cards.fact: SPACE IR sits after gate. Partition 1 small (64-256) sets latency; later partitions cheap tail. Precompute H(f) off-thread. No fopen/malloc in run(). IR swap atomic or crossfade. Check isfinite and DC on load. Report first-partition latency. Cab IR is not hall IR. Unknown license = REVIEW_REQUIRED. Do not ship proprietary IR in the VST. FFmpeg/librosa are offline only.

cards.tags: mix-ready energy frost sludge chainsaw sag hiss death stoner black doom
cards.fact: Genre is energy+mix slot on the same THALL chain. Axes: attack density frost sludge chainsaw sag hiss sustain. Banks: THALL DJENT DOOM BLACK_METAL DEATH_METAL DEATH_HM2 STONER CLEAN_AMBIENT MODERN_METAL. MASTER is mix trim, GAIN is saturation. A/B after loudness match. Details: apps/shared/MIX_READY.md and presets.json.
